test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 16 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Find the least number which when divided by 20, 25, 35 and 40 leaves remainders 14, 19, 29 and 34, respectively.
solution: Given: Divisor 1 = 20, Remainder 1 = 14 Divisor 2 = 25, Remainder 2 = 19 Divisor 3 = 35, Remainder 3 = 29 Divisor 4 = 40, Remainder 4 = 34 Observation: The difference between each divisor and its corresponding remainder is constant: 20 - 14 = 6 25 - 19 = 6
